annotator_limitation: Single-pass LLM labels, one annotator, no second judge and therefore no Cohen's kappa. Adequate for a generalization feasibility test; NOT benchmark ground truth.
blinding: Labelled from extraction_generalization_blinded.json only. holds_gold, sampling stratum, extractor output and detector predictions were all unseen at labelling time.
contradiction_criterion: CONTRADICTION requires the two answers to assert things that cannot both be true. CRITICAL CORPUS PROPERTY: each subagent holds a DIFFERENT evidence partition, so 'my documents do/do not contain X' is partition-relative and two agents can both be correct. Such pairs are labelled NO_CONTRADICTION. Only claims about the WORLD (or about the SAME named source) can genuinely conflict.
assertion_span_criterion: The sentence(s) carrying each agent's main assertion, quoted verbatim from its answer, marked before seeing any extractor output.
